Context: FREOUENTL Y ASKED QUESTIONS

6. What is the period of retention of lien in the parent department in case of a permanent Government servant appointed in another Central Government Office I State Government?  
His lien may be retained in the parent department for a period of 2 years. If the official is not confirmed within a period of 2 years due to some reason, he may be permitted to retain the lien in the parent department for one more year.
